bull_bear.body:
- Way forward includes "Improving RoCE and RoE ratios by monitoring volume and price growth"; returns are currently depressed - RoE/RoCE of 21.6%/27.1% (FY22) fell to 9.2%/12.2% (FY23), 11.3%/13.8% (FY24), 2.8%/3.6% (FY25) and 4.5%/6.2% (FY26).
- Net Worth has grown steadily: INR 1,265 Cr (FY22), 1,364 Cr, 1,544 Cr, 1,576 Cr and 1,646 Cr (FY26).
- Credit rating is CRISIL A+ with Outlook: NEGATIVE.
- Growth funded partly through inorganic bolt-ons (Trubore, Aquel/Bhuj) rather than only greenfield capacity.
- The deck states no dividend policy, buyback, payout ratio or debt-reduction target.
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation policy (investor deck)

business.body: PVC volumes flat amid industry -9% degrowth in Q2; CPVC grew strongly across India; bathware revenue INR12cr in Q2 (up 71% YoY), consolidated H1 loss INR10cr; project business now 25% of revenue (up from 15%), targeting 20-25% CAGR in project segment
business.title: Segment / subsidiary detail

business.body:
- Describes itself as "one of India's largest integrated piping solutions providers", "Amongst TOP 5 PROCESSORS in Piping Industry" and the "Industry's Most TRUSTED BRAND", with operations spanning agriculture, plumbing and borewell categories.
- Claims to be "building the widest sewerage range and underground drainage solutions", with sewerage & underground listed as a "New Addition to the Portfolio".
- Brand strength cited as being "among the Top 2 Most Desired Brands in the Pipes Category - as declared by TRA Research" (2024).
- Distribution moat framed as an "extensive pan-India distribution network of over 1,500 channel partners", described as "Long term and relationship driven" and "an integral part of business delivery".
- Investment rationale rests on "Huge headroom for domestic growth - with Per Capita PVC Consumption lowest in India compared globally" and "Long term demand visibility led by Real Estate, Industrial Agriculture & infrastructure".
business.title: Positioning (investor deck)

business.body:
- [Promoter/board] Founder-led: Mr. Jayant S. Chheda (Founder, Chairman & MD, founder member since incorporation), Mr. Parag J. Chheda (JMD, with the company since 1994) and Mr. Vipul J. Chheda (Executive Director, 28 years); independent directors include Mr. Rajendra Gogri (ex-CMD Aarti Industries), Mrs. Amisha Vora (CMD, Prabhudas Lilladher Group) and Mr. Ankur Bansal (Co-Founder, BlackSoil).
- [Labour code] An exceptional item of INR 2.05 Cr net of tax in FY26 represents an "estimated increase in provision for employee benefits arising from the implementation of the New Labour Code".
- [Branding spend] Heavy consumer-brand push described - Mumbai AC local train branding, bus-route branding in Madhya Pradesh, outdoor sites in Rajasthan and Gujarat, digital initiatives, Plumbex Bengaluru 2026 participation, and the new campaign "INDIA KI PRAGATI KA TAJ"; Akshay Kumar cited as brand ambassador in the growth journey.
- [Asset-light history] The timeline claims the company was an "Early mover in Eastern India with a unique asset light model" (2014), a model the deck does not otherwise describe.

themes.title: Building-materials & home-improvement up-cycle
themes.need: The residential up-cycle pulls a broad finishing/home-improvement basket - tiles & sanitaryware (KAJARIACER/CERA/SOMANYCERA/ORIENTBELL/HINDWAREAP), wood-panels & laminates (CENTURYPLY/GREENPANEL/GREENLAM/RUSHIL/STYLAMIND), pipes/adhesives (PIDILITIND/SUPREMEIND/ASTRAL-tier) and paints (ASIANPAINT/CARYSIL/SIRCA). Premiumization + GST formalization shift share to organized players.
themes.driver: Festive/real-estate completion demand; GST 2.0 + commodity tailwinds; capacity commissioning and channel restocking.

themes.title: PVC piping & building finishing
themes.need: Polymer-pipe and home-finishing plays are driven by agri/plumbing/real-estate finishing demand and PVC resin spreads - distinct from the value-added STEEL-tube structural/capex thesis.
themes.driver: Agri/plumbing/real-estate finishing demand and PVC resin-spread normalization.
